objective: Measure sensitivity to the amount of historical data available to the existing factor gate; do not select the best-performing window.
why_no_756d_variant: The current 2023 start cannot provide an independent 756-day window over the full common active period; fetching 2022 data would be a separate dataset version.

stability_metrics.factor_decision: pairwise weekly Jaccard of PASS factor sets
stability_metrics.signal_selection: pairwise weekly Jaccard of newly selected Top10 symbols before turnover carryover
stability_metrics.style_weight: pairwise weekly L1 distance of style weight vectors
stability_metrics.performance: total return, annualized excess, information ratio, volatility, maximum drawdown
stability_metrics.execution: actual target turnover, nominal holdings, holdings above 10bp and 50bp, effective position count
